sum: Oxbridge Re Holdings Limited focuses on building complementary growth platforms focused on AI infrastructure and digital financial infrastructure. The company, through its SurancePlus platform, engages in the tokenization of real-world assets by developing blockchain-based platforms to offer tokenized reinsurance securities. It provides property and casualty reinsurance solutions serving insurers in the Gulf Coast region of the United States. The company also, through AI GridWorks, focuses on developing, owning, and operating AI data centers and the supporting infrastructure for AI compute. Oxbridge Re Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in George Town, the Cayman Islands.
